Step 1. GET https://<posthog-api-host>/api/projects/117863/file_download_batch_exports/01a10d89-1ee8-0000-3e2c-9000712c9502/download/01a10d89-3a26-0000-56f3-e1f6c4004610/ with header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Let the client follow the single 302 redirect to the temporary signed URL. Do NOT log, store, print or forward the Location header / signed URL anywhere. Save the response body as raw bytes to tasks/code-red-20261004/runtime/handbacks/coo/export-validation-01/parts/posthog-hogql-01a10d89-1ee8-0000-3e2c-9000712c9502-01a10d89-3a26-0000-56f3-e1f6c4004610.jsonl (no compression was requested, so the body is plain JSONLines).
Step 2. Record the saved file's sha256 and byte length.
Step 3. Parse as JSONLines (one JSON object per non-empty line). Verify and record: exactly 3 rows; each row's key set is exactly these 21 names in this order: uuid, event, timestamp_s, evidence_version_json, auth_state_at_event_json, account_id_at_event_json, analytics_consent_at_event_json, filing_id_json, summary_id_json, request_id_json, logical_request_id_json, client_attempt_json, transport_attempt_json, identity_evidence_json, consent_evidence_json, outcome_json, delivery_path_json, summary_service_invoked_json, duration_ms_json, reason_json, entry_point_json; the uuid values are exactly 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010, 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011, 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012; event values summary_viewed, summary_request_started, summary_request_finished; timestamp_s equals 1790553600, 1790553601, 1790553602 (record whether rendered as integer or string); rows ordered by timestamp then uuid (the query's ORDER BY). Step 4. Write parts/VERIFICATION.json beside the part: endpoint used (host + path; no query string, no signed URL), HTTP status of the redirect and of the body fetch, file name, bytes, sha256, row count, key-set check, uuid check, value renderings, deviations, UTC timestamps.
Step 5. Stop conditions: if the GET returns 401/403 (auth), 404/410 (run or file no longer available) or any body mentioning payment, plan, billing, trial or quota, STOP and report the status and text verbatim; do NOT start a new export (a second create requires new authorization).
